mathematical_contract.parallel_convention: BezierParallel2 uses the signed left normal (-Hy,Hx)/sqrt(S). The circle, selected-half, and diameter radical coefficients use that same convention; this checkpoint corrects the three historical opposite signs and verifies actual offset endpoints against the selected circle.
mathematical_contract.component_detection: After reduction in the retained cusp field, an identically-zero A^2 S-B^2 circle fiber is positive-dimensional. Source regularity certifies S>0 over the retained analytic range.
mathematical_contract.branch_selection: The rational term A is first proved root-free by a strict fiber sign certificate when possible; otherwise all selected-fiber roots of A are projected. A rational sample is chosen in a certified root-free cell, so A+B/sqrt(S)=0 selects the authored branch without the possibility of sampling an isolated common zero.
mathematical_contract.opposite_branch: If the sampled unsquared equation is nonzero, the opposite radical branch owns the component. Its only possible authored-branch contacts satisfy A=B=0, so the projected A roots are replayed as complete isolated candidates through the ordinary exact contact path.
mathematical_contract.semicircle_clipping: On the selected circle branch, roots of the squared selected-half expression partition the analytic range. Each candidate and cell is replayed through the unsquared expression; positive cells become overlaps, negative cells are rejected, and surviving zero-only cells become endpoint contacts.
mathematical_contract.endpoint_mapping: One shared reduced parameter map orders compact cusp parameters. Each contact carries one correlation bit: projected half-plane roots use their nondegenerate relation, while authored range endpoints use independent exact signs and never treat an identically-zero circle equation as root-identity evidence.
mathematical_contract.policy: Every exact predicate receives CurveContext. STRICT accepts only certified decisions. APPROXIMATE_512 may terminate only through the shared Hyperlimit/Hypersolve 512-bit predicate boundary and records that consumption; no geometry is converted to binary floating point.
